- Date: `2026-04-17`
  Link: [Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-design-anthropic-labs?lang=us)
  Summary: Anthropic launched `Claude Design` in research preview, positioned to generate designs, interactive prototypes, slides, and one-pagers using Claude Opus 4.7. Rollout is to Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise tiers.
  Why it matters: This is a material product expansion beyond chat/coding into visual knowledge-work, and it signals Anthropic is testing higher-value workflow surfaces rather than only model upgrades.
